summary: When forward iteration exhausts a full 0..=65535 interval, incrementing forward_offset overflows. The parent returns without consuming the interval, causing subsequent next() calls to repeat 65535 indefinitely. The fix consumes the exhausted interval before returning. The proposed reversal removes only that forward-path correction. Blocked: no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit. The fix adds no tests; bitmap::store::interval_store::tests::iter_u16_max stops its iteration loops before exhaustion and checks nth(65535) without checking the following value, so it does not detect this regression. No builds or tests were run.
